title: feat(insights): introduce `insights` middleware (1/4)
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces `insights` middleware.
It is to automatically setup userToken across search calls and Insights api calls.
Once this middleware is added to `instantSearchInstance`, when user calls

```js
window.aa('setUserToken', userToken);
// or 
insightsClient('setUserToken', userToken);
```

the middleware will automatically apply the userToken to the searchParameters. Then the next search call will include this userToken.

**Stacked PRs**

1. [introduce `insights` middleware](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4446) ← current
2. [send events from hits and refinementList](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4456)
3. [implement sendEvent in all the connectors](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4463)
4. [add tests](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4464)

**examples**

* basic example: https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-jetcz?file=/src/app.js
* with search-insights **umd**: https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-zn81s?file=/src/app.js
* `insightsClient: false`: https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-1igbb?file=/src/app.js
  (*working example*: [esm](https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-5qwf4?file=/src/app.js), [umd]())
